resources.name: lookup_communities_2024-02-23
resources.title: Lookup Table of Communities
resources.description: This lookup table cross references ids of communities from various sources. In the Energy Statistics Workbooks, community name is the primary identifier but string matching can be cumbersome, so geographic positions, census codes, PCE reporting ids, and GNIS identifiers are also included. For context, there is also Alaska Energy Authority (AEA) Energy Regions and Alaska Native Regional Corporations. Note: This table was not used as the basis for the set of communities used in the Alaska Energy Data Gateway v3.0 (AEDG).

contributors.title: Neil McMahon
contributors.comment: First pulled data from the original sources, and compiled, corrected, harmonized, transformed it into Excel Workbooks as annual datasets 2011-2021. This process required a collection of lookup tables for elements such as power plants, power plant operators, sales reporting entities, and grids. These lookup tables were updated in the spring of 2025.

contributors.organization: Alaska Center for Energy and Power (ACEP) at the University of Alaska Fairbanks (UAF)
contributors.comment:
1. Contracted Neil McMahon to produce the 2011-2021 Workbooks, and then posted them in GitHub for distribution.
2. Contracted Neil McMahon in the spring of 2025 to update the lookup tables so that future production of the Alaska Energy Statistics Tables could be performed internally at ACEP.
3. Translated tabs in the Excel workbook of lookup tables into CSV files. There are some problems with the variable types of codes because of the treatment of missing values by the Python script that did the extraction.

contributors.organization: Alaska Center for Energy and Power (ACEP) at the University of Alaska Fairbanks (UAF)
contributors.comment: Documented sources and defined the data dictionary using OEMetadata (Frictionless) formatted metadata https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.15019561.

fields.name: census_code
fields.description: Communities are identified by a 5-digit Federal Information Processing Series (FIPS) codes, formerly referred to as FIPS55, assigned and maintained by the Census Bureau

fields.name: gnis_feature_id
fields.description: Numeric identifier for the community determined by Geographic Names Information System (GNIS) code maintained by the USGS

fields.name: pce_reporting_id
fields.description: Six Digit Accounting code used by AEA for PCE reporters

fields.name: aea_energy_region_id
fields.description: Numeric code for the energy region defined by the Alaska Energy Authority for statistical and analysis purposes

fields.name: aea_energy_region
fields.description: One of 11 regions defined by the Alaska Energy Authority for statistical and analysis purposes

fields.name: alaska_native_regional_corporation_id
fields.description: Numeric code for the Alaska Native Regional Corporation that contains the community, perhaps internal to these tables.

fields.name: alaska_native_regional_corporation_name
fields.description: Name of the Alaska Native Regional Corporation that contains the community

fields.name: census_area_id
fields.description: Numeric code to represent the Alaska borough or census area. These codes may be internal to these tables.

fields.name: census_area_census_code
fields.description: County subdivision FIPS code or Zip code?. 5-digit Federal Information Processing Series (FIPS) codes, formerly referred to as FIPS55, assigned and maintained by the Census Bureau.

fields.name: census_area_county_code
fields.description: The Alaska borough or census area that contains the community identified by a 5-digit Federal Information Processing Series (FIPS) codes, formerly referred to as FIPS55, assigned and maintained by the Census Bureau.

fields.name: census_area_gnis_feature_id
fields.description: The Alaska borough or census area that contains the community identified by Geographic Names Information System (GNIS) code maintained by the USGS

fields.name: census_area_historical
fields.description: Boolean indicating if the Alaska borough or census area described is a historical version.

fields.name: census_area_name
fields.description: Name of the Alaska borough or census area that contains the community. Boroughs are analagous to a county in other places. Organized boroughs were formed in those areas where economies were better developed. The remaining areas are the unorganized borough, which is divided into census areas; these areas exist for statistical analysis and do not have a government of their own. There are also consolidated city-borough governments.

fields.name: census_area_notes
fields.description: Notes that describe changes made to boroughs and census areas in time
